coverage_limits: All 48 sector source-index entries have now been checked across the two dated packets: 45 explicit numbered Walking sections with 484 species/form rows. Bleu Sector 2, Bleu Sector 10 and Magenta Sector 5 remain missing from the reviewed RotomLabs numbered-sector index.

The continuation reviews 29 numbered Walking sections with 312 rows: Vert 114, Rouge 90, Jaune 108. It also inventories 58 separate Alpha rows and four Static Encounter rows; inventory is not an automatic runtime classification or certification.
Bisafans' area-specific Pokémon rows are used only for the area they name. Its generic random-spawn list, explicitly independent of area, is excluded from sector corroboration.

Independent named-area agreement corroborates membership and ordinary class. Roof, rain, night, rarity, percentage and level details remain attributed unless previously corroborated; disagreements are retained, not averaged or silently chosen.

RotomLabs' question marks do not establish unrestricted time, weather, floor or unlock conditions. Its nested Wild Zone links do not turn a source table into a certified non-overlapping spatial census.

Alpha headings do not distinguish fixed from random Alpha. The separately recorded form-specific Alpha reports remain unclassified leads even where two sources agree. Existing Patrat and Garbodor identities are retained.
Bisafans names Pidgey at Rouge Sector 4 while RotomLabs lists Pidgeot. That discrepancy stays a research lead, not an inferred absence or ordinary supported Pidgey habitat.

The four Static Encounter records are not used to create or qualify ordinary claims. Rouge Sector 8 Bunnelby also has a separate Walking row (12–14); its static level-10 report does not certify that ordinary row. Yveltal, Vert Sector 8 Garbodor and Jaune Sector 7 Emolga are not added as ordinary encounters.
Meadow labels for Scatterbug and Spewpa are source grouping labels, not a distinct visible form. Vivillon patterns and flower forms remain explicit attributed records, not a complete form census.

The first packet's 446-source-row/718-model-row checkpoint remains unchanged. This continuation changes only Vert/Rouge/Jaune encounter rows, not Bleu/Magenta, Wild Zones, geometry, owner photos, navigation, progress or saved data.

Artifact hashes identify the authored review and reconciliation files. Original website bytes and game observations have not been newly captured, and no comprehensive roster or master-plan completion is asserted.
